name: Methodological and statistical issues weaken the reported VASCO nuclear-test correlation
summary: Watters and colleagues report that the nuclear-test timing correlation becomes statistically insignificant after normalization by the relevant observation days and identify additional dataset-validation, artifact and spatial-distribution problems. VASCO researchers dispute aspects of that assessment and cite separate replication efforts.

editorialNotes.caution: GreyAlien does not characterize the dispute as conclusively settled; the claim records the findings of the peer-reviewed critique and preserves the VASCO response as competing context.
